title: SG-6.1.3 Validate scene characters against the world's character list
summary: World content validation rejects scene characters whose id is not in world.yaml characters, with a path-tagged issue.
description: Context: SceneDef.characters (CharacterSpec[]) is accepted by sceneSchema, but validateWorld in game/src/content/loader.ts only checks dialogue speakers and say events against world.characters, so a scene character with an unknown id passes validation. Desired behavior: validateWorld reports each unknown scene character id with a path-tagged issue. Expected result: unknown ids are rejected and unit tests prove it. Why: scene NPCs must reference declared world characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene character whose id is not in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then the returned errors contain an entry tagged with the path scenes.<sceneId>.characters.<index>.id naming the unknown id
Given a world whose scene characters all exist in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then no character-related error is returned and the-boys-room content still validates

out_of_scope: character interaction dialogue or action event checks
preserve: existing 'unknown character: <id>' messages for speakers and say events

technical_constraints: Errors stay plain strings returned from validateWorld(world): string[]
definition_of_done: Unknown scene character ids are reported
